selectFile.where: Audio player: empty state before an audio file is chosen

skipBack.where: Audio player: screen-reader label of the skip-back button

pause.where: Audio player: screen-reader label of the play/pause button while playing

play.where: Audio player: screen-reader label of the play/pause button while paused

skipForward.where: Audio player: screen-reader label of the skip-forward button

unmute.where: Audio player: screen-reader label of the mute button while muted

mute.where: Audio player: screen-reader label of the mute button
